breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula that includes the product of inertia Iyz throughout all calculations. It explicitly instructs to use Iyz = 800000 mm^4 in both the numerator terms (My·Iz − Mz·Iyz) and (Mz·Iy − My·Iyz) and in the denominator (Iy·Iz − Iyz^2). There is no instruction to ignore or zero out the product of inertia, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth approach.
